summary: Store architecture, decisions, contracts, dependencies, useful verified findings/failures and unresolved questions. Exclude logs, bulk reports, full source copies, binaries, credentials and runtime assets. Target a few KiB per record;32KiB is the limit. Combined curated archives warn at50MiB/refuse100MiB. SQLite size and retrieval are measured separately.
title: Curate relevant findings within explicit byte budgets
